hooks.command: $gitDir = git rev-parse --git-dir 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $gitDir) { exit 0 }; $flag = Join-Path $gitDir 'claude-codex-review-needed'; if (-not (Test-Path $flag)) { exit 0 }; Remove-Item $flag -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $changes = git status --porcelain; if (-not $changes) { exit 0 }; $review = codex review --uncommitted 2>&1 | Out-String; $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE; $message = "Codex review completed with exit code $exitCode.``n``n$review"; @{ systemMessage = $message } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
